name: Argentiferous-Cwm
description: Rolling continents break around shallow seas, their interiors scored by a nearby asteroid belt. Beyond an orbital debris ring, the land runs to a horizon that feels hand-drawn.
Standing still, you feel the temperate air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself.
The oldest impact basin predates the system's estimated age by a comfortable margin. The survey bureau has quietly stopped publishing the numbers.
The charts mark this world in cautious amber. Those who ignore the marking tend to come back rich, changed, or not at all.
